purpose: Post-submission deterministic review/execution contract for Mitosis persistence, Tenki clean-room verification, replay integrity, and objective game outcomes.
invariants: Credential presence is not provider authentication.
Secret scanning must detect synthetic mi_, tk_, Bearer, AWS access-key, and private-key fixtures.
Mitosis persistence PASS requires write, query-back, exact universal-ID equality, and get-by-ID confirmation.
Tenki code review and Tenki execution verification are independent evidence classes.
Tenki artifact reconstruction PASS requires fresh sandbox creation, exact source pin, and playthrough verification inside that sandbox.
Tenki environment replay PASS additionally requires replay-from-start, step-hash equality, and final-MMR equality from actual environment re-execution.

Portable/load-bearing memory PASS requires Tenki verification writeback to Mitosis, exact-ID retrieval, Vithia consumption of that exact memory, and a DecisionFCO causally referencing the resulting verified context.
One-player score comparisons are evaluation winners, not literal game wins.
Two-player match winner is determined only from verified final environment scores under a frozen predicate; ties remain ties.
Positive score, termination, or semantic description alone cannot establish a literal game win.
Historical atoms, receipts, traces, and roots are append-only and are never rewritten to make replay pass.
